old_problem: The active five-cycle Ethernet test lacked an exact BF3 BDF/netdev/physical-port/peer/IP map, approved flap mechanism, timing/loss oracle, LED legend, alternate management and recovery. DeepSeek's static first/broad-vendor status collection proved no transition or durability.

test_case.test_name: Five-cycle per-port BlueField Ethernet flap, reachability and LED recovery
test_case.purpose: Prove each mapped BlueField Ethernet port transitions through five controlled down/up cycles with correct carrier, ping reachability and physical indication, then returns to stable operation without configuration drift or errors.
required_package: Approved OS administrative or physical fixture flap mechanism per port
Five-cycle down/up dwell, carrier deadline, ping count/interval/timeout/allowed-loss and recovery-latency oracle
Hardware-revision Ethernet LED legend and operator visual evidence method
Traffic/workload isolation, independent management/OOB, maintenance window and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: With alternate management and exact Ethernet mapping verified, preserve address/route/link/counter/log baseline. A qualified operator applies the approved down then up mechanism to one mapped Ethernet port for exactly five indexed cycles while automation records complete carrier, speed/duplex, bounded ping, counters and logs and the operator records the physical indication. After cycle five, prove original configuration, link, peer traffic and services are restored.
test_case.expected_result: For each mapped Ethernet port and all five cycles, down is observed within deadline and the declared ping path fails under the signed oracle; up restores carrier/speed/duplex and ping within deadline and the physical indication matches its legend; no disallowed error/configuration drift occurs and final service is stable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every indexed down/up transition, target-bound carrier and ping results, required physical evidence and final restored state. Static ethtool/dmesg output, one link-up observation, InfiniBand state or fewer than five cycles cannot pass.
safety_gate: Prove alternate management/OOB and isolate production traffic before flapping any Ethernet port
Operate only the exact mapped PF/netdev/physical port; do not alter addresses/routes or broad vendor-selected interfaces
Qualified operator owns disruptive/physical action and observes LED state; preserve full per-cycle logs
Stop on wrong port, management/traffic loss outside scope, configuration drift, error or failed up transition; restore once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Complete Ethernet BDF/PF/netdev/MAC/physical/peer/IP/ping topology and flap mechanism
Baseline configuration, peer/traffic state and alternate-management proof
Five indexed down/up carrier/speed/duplex/ping/counter/log records per port
Timestamped per-cycle or representative signed LED observations under the approved legend
Final configuration diff, restored link/traffic/services and error evidence
test_case.recovery: On a failed up transition or unexpected outage, stop remaining cycles, use independent OOB, restore only the affected port's approved administrative/cable state once, verify address/route/link/peer services and preserve the failed-cycle evidence. Do not switch to an InfiniBand recovery or retry automatically.
